---
title: Who touches what
description: "The chain is the referee. Your browser builds your entry from the chain itself; Jōge's servers only keep rounds moving, and anyone can do their job."
---

<Figure legend={<><Key swatch="you">your money</Key><Key swatch="signed">signed price</Key><span className="ms-auto text-muted-ink">mainnet</span></>}>
  <SystemFigure />
</Figure>

| Part | What it is | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Contracts | CashScript and SolidCash covenants holding every round, gate, ticket and vault | `packages/contracts` |
| SDK | oracle messages, commitments, payout maths, lanes; shared by browser and engine | `packages/sdk` |
| Web app | Next.js: every page, the read API, a live stream, Sensei | `apps/web` |
| Engine | one Node process: oracle relay, price line, indexer, keeper, agents, alerts | `services/engine` |
| Database | Postgres: a read model rebuilt from raw transactions | `packages/db` |
| Chart · Brain | the canvas chart; the model layer | `packages/chart` · `packages/brain` |

## Three rules

| Rule | How |
|---|---|
| Your browser trusts the chain, not us | entries are built from live coins on public Bitcoin Cash servers, and the contracts check every entry whatever our database says; only an agent vault's address and its withdrawal come from our server |
| Nobody has to be online | the lock and settle after an entry have one valid form, payouts are fixed at settlement, and none of them needs a key ([2.3](/docs/round/anyone-can-finish)) |
| AI never holds your money | Sensei only suggests; agents sign from a vault that can only buy tickets that pay you ([4.3](/docs/agents/vault)) |
